tools.name: create_note
tools.description: Save a note, idea, or thought for later. Use when the user wants to jot down or note something, or remember a fact or piece of information. Not for 'remember to do something' requests - those are reminders.

parameters.name: text
parameters.description: The text of the note, usually a direct quote from the user

tools.name: create_reminder
tools.description: Set a reminder optionally for a future time. Use when the user requests a reminder, asks to remember to do something ('remind me to...', 'remember to...'), or wants to be reminded at a specific time or date.

parameters.name: date_time_human
parameters.description: If provided by the user, the date and/or time to remind the user in human readable format. Must be in English — translate it if the user spoke another language. e.g. 'tomorrow at 13:00', 'next Monday at 9am', 'on July 5th at 14:30', 'at 3pm'

parameters.name: duration_human
parameters.description: If provided by the user, the duration from now to remind the user in human readable format. Must be in English — translate it if the user spoke another language. e.g. 'in 2 hours', 'in 30 minutes', 'in 1 day and 3 hours'

parameters.name: notification_hours_before
parameters.description: If the user requests to be reminded before the reminder time, set the number of hours here, for example 'before Monday' would be 24 hours notice, but 'before 3pm' would be 1 hour notice.

parameters.name: message
parameters.description: The message to remind the user e.g. 'Buy more milk'

tools.name: create_list_item
tools.description: Add an item to a shopping list, grocery list, or to-do list. Use when the user names a list or wants to buy groceries, food, or household supplies.

parameters.name: list_name
parameters.description: The name of the list to add the item to e.g. 'shopping', 'todo'. Use a short search term keyword, e.g. 'shopping' instead of 'my shopping list' to improve matching with existing lists.

parameters.name: message
parameters.description: The text of the list item to add

parameters.name: reminder_date_time_human
parameters.description: If provided by the user, the date and/or time to remind the user of the list item in human readable format. Must be in English — translate it if the user spoke another language. e.g. 'tomorrow at 13:00'

tools.name: create_list
tools.description: Create a new, empty list. ONLY use this when the user's message contains the exact phrase 'Create a new list', e.g. 'Create a new list travel' or 'Create a new list called travel'. Never use it for any other phrasing, and never use it to add items to a list.

parameters.name: list_name
parameters.description: The name of the new list, e.g. 'travel' for 'Create a new list called travel'

tools.name: set_alarm
tools.description: Set an alarm for a specific clock time like 8am or 16:30.

parameters.name: time_hours
parameters.description: The hour component of the alarm time (24 hour time)

parameters.name: time_minutes
parameters.description: The minute component of the alarm time (0-59)

parameters.name: label
parameters.description: An optional label or title for the alarm

tools.name: set_timer
tools.description: Set a timer for the specified duration or end time

parameters.name: time_human
parameters.description: The duration or target end time to set the timer for in human readable format e.g. '1 hour and 30 minutes', '45 minutes', 'for 1:50pm', 'at 13:30'
